name: Weather
summary: Now, the next few hours and the next few days for your city, no account needed.
description:
Current conditions, today's high, low, chance of rain and wind, the next six hours, and a four-day outlook, from Open-Meteo's free forecast service. Set your city in the widget's settings.

This widget connects to Open-Meteo to look up your city and fetch the forecast. Nothing else leaves your computer.
